name:
Mario Kart 7
Update data
description:
An update for Mario Kart 7 is now available from Nintendo eShop.
All customers who own a copy of Mario Kart 7 should download the update. This will update the software to Version 1.2 with the following amendments:

- Various bugs have been fixed in order to provide a smoother gaming experience.

â€¢ Once the update has been downloaded, it will be installed automatically.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and recommend downloading this update to ensure a smooth game experience.
disclaimer: This is an update for Mario Kart™ 7 to resolve shortcut exploits in online multiplayer mode. After downloading, confirmation of the update will be visible under System Settings > Data Management > Nintendo 3DS > Add-On Content. This update is required for online multiplayer mode. Deleting the update will require you to download it again to play multiplayer online. You can still play single-player or local multiplayer without installing the update.
